why: Drops the write count from the eligibility test: a byte-identical status line is unsatisfiable again (DEBUG-NOTES 2026-09-18, 'A fourth load-sensitive spec').

name: any text counts as settled
why: Makes every non-null text eligible: a trigger that did nothing is reported as settled on the stale line, the opposite failure.
